description_md:
# **Rush Hour**

## **[PLAYTHROUGH VERSUS EXPERT VENOM GOBLIN](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dK0rq86Ixw4&ab_channel=Web-WarriorFanatic)**

## **[PLAYTHROUGH VERSUS EXPERT MAGNETO](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DIPWuyUWSNA&ab_channel=Web-WarriorFanatic)**

## **[Deck Profile & Explanation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q2i0W_UE3YM&ab_channel=Web-WarriorFanatic)**

### _**Jubilee & Nick Fury working with the beat cop police force unleashes the ultimate combo!**_

[Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) is the most unique card in the game. It's the only player side scheme that does not go into the victory display when its defeated, meaning it can be cleared multiple times per game. This unlocks really powerful combos, the most notable being the ability to spam the strongest card in the game, [Nick Fury](https://marvelcdb.com/card/01084).

[Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) states that heroes and allies cannot remove threat from this scheme, which means only alter-egos and supports can. Aside from using [Disguise](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47013) in alter-ego, [Beat Cop](https://marvelcdb.com/card/10029) can remove threat from [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) whether Jubilee herself is in hero or alter-ego. I prefer [Beat Cop](https://marvelcdb.com/card/10029) over [Surveillance Team](https://marvelcdb.com/card/01064) because it can stay in play forever. Jubilee also has the high economy to afford a more expensive support. When 2 [Beat Cops](https://marvelcdb.com/card/10029) are in play, we can clear off [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) every turn.

The biggest key to this combo is [Chance Encounter](https://marvelcdb.com/card/26034), which we can attach to [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) to grab [Nick Fury](https://marvelcdb.com/card/01084) every time we clear it. Being able to play the most flexible ally in the game almost every turn for draw power/threat removal/damage will give Jubilee's shopping a high payout and crush the villain.

### _**Other notable cards:**_

[Mutant Education](https://marvelcdb.com/card/37021) feels like its made for Jubilee. Jubilee's alter-ego action, Mall Rat, can only search the deck for [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003). This means while the side scheme is in the discard pile, we can't recur it. [Mutant Education](https://marvelcdb.com/card/37021) constantly shuffles it back into the deck so that Mall Rat can immediately put it back into play.

[Cell Phone](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47019) is an item card that's reusable and a good target for [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) after all our other items are already in play. Honestly, we don't even need the "when defeated" effect of [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) because [Nick Fury](https://marvelcdb.com/card/01084) is strong enough to carry the game, but [Cell Phone](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47019) is essentially a free card to play because of the amount of times we're clearing [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003). This item is also much better in multiplayer to allow us to make basic activations out of turn.

[Skilled Investigator](https://marvelcdb.com/card/04047) is a difficult card to navigate in this deck, but still worth it. Jubilee has multiple ways to clear side schemes in alter-ego, but [Skilled Investigator](https://marvelcdb.com/card/04047) is a hero response and only triggers when we're in hero form. It's important to always pay attention to sequencing to make sure we can trigger [Skilled Investigator](https://marvelcdb.com/card/04047) before flipping down and the [Beat Cops](https://marvelcdb.com/card/10029) will help heavily with that.

### _**Jubilee & Nick Loves Side Schemes**_

We're running a total of 5 player side schemes and [One Way or Another](https://marvelcdb.com/card/22015) in this deck to have more side schemes available in case we don't have a reliable way to clear [Shopping Spree](https://marvelcdb.com/card/47003) early game. "Cable Impersonator" was my alternate deck name for this list.

### _**Conclusion**_

I was really excited to showcase this deck out for you guys, but unfortunately don't have access to Jubilee yet. Hopefully this deck runs as smoothly as I'm imagining and I would love to hear your feedback. Hope you enjoy this list!

Update: After playing this deck, I have to say it is extremely difficult to pilot. The responses for alter-ego or hero form makes sequencing complex...but when everything clicks together the payout is definitely worth it :)
